About Me

Bridging science
and real-world impact

I am a recent Bachelor of Agricultural Engineering graduate from Universitas Jambi (GPA 3.79/4.00), with hands-on experience in peatland research, field program management, and community stakeholder engagement.

My work spans from leading experimental field research across 48 plots in tropical peatland to facilitating farmer field schools across Central Kalimantan as part of a national peatland restoration program (BRGM).

I am driven by the intersection of data-driven strategy and community-first execution — skills I am eager to apply in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

Research

Field research with
measurable outcomes

Combining experimental design, data collection, and evidence-based recommendations to drive sustainable agricultural practices.

Lead Researcher
Effect of Biostimulants on Alstonia pneumatophora Back. Growth in Peat Soil
June – July 2025 · Teluk Pengkah, Jambi
Spearheaded a peatland cultivation study on an endemic timber species. Developed and field-tested an organic biofertilizer (F1 Embio) that raised peat soil pH from 3.5 to 6.8. Generated ESG-compliant plantation recommendations.
